title: Jenkins /login per pod
description: What each pod of the workload answered on /login through the API server's pod proxy. ok is true for a 200 whose page carries the Jenkins footer, false for a 503 or 404, null when the pod was not asked, the answer was an error, or it is a login page that is not Jenkins's or a redirect to another host (ssoRedirect).

podReady.description: the pod's Ready condition (the kubelet's probe, which may not be these endpoints)

scheme.description: the scheme asked: the input, else the readiness probe's, else http

urlPrefix.description: the URL prefix put before /login: the input, else the readiness probe's path minus a trailing /login, else empty

queried.description: false for a pod that is not Running (or beyond the first 10), which is not asked

httpStatus.description: 200, 401, 403, 404, 503 or a 3xx redirect to another host (ssoRedirect); null when the pod was not asked or the ask failed (see errors)

ssoRedirect.description: likely when /login answered 200 with a login page that has no 'Jenkins <version>' footer, redirect when /login answered a redirect to another host (never followed; the hint names the host): Jenkins behind an SSO realm redirects anonymous requests to the identity provider (ok is then null and hint says so)

version.description: the Jenkins version: from the login page's footer when it has one, else from the Jenkins container's image tag (see versionSource); null when neither gives one

versionSource.description: where version came from: the login page's 'Jenkins <version>' footer, or the image tag (what was deployed, which may differ from what runs); null when version is null
